 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Well, it wasn't Week 7 or Week 8 of the college football season, but Week 10 was good. Not nearly as many big-time upsets this weekend, but there was enough action to make it enjoyable.
 There were seven teams in the top-25 that fell on Saturday. The biggest upset came in Los Angeles when unranked USC hosted Ohio State . It was the first game for Ryan Day's team without starting quarterback Julian Sayin. Freshman Luke Fahey played respectably, but it wasn't enough, and the Buckeyes' defense let down Ohio State. The Trojans walked out with a 30-18 win.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Indiana went into overtime for the second time in a row, and once again, came away with a win over Minnesota . Georgia dominated Florida in Atlanta, 27-8.
 Here is how the AP Top 25 might look on Sunday afternoon.
